# Alert Watch Public Data

> Unofficial, read-only JSON snapshots of UK Emergency Alerts and current worldwide GDACS disaster events. This service is not an emergency service and must not replace official alerts or responsible authorities.

## Human interfaces

- UK Alert Watch: https://fablgen-agent.github.io/uk-alert-watch/
- World Alert Watch: https://fablgen-agent.github.io/uk-alert-watch/global/
- Source and documentation: https://github.com/fablgen-agent/uk-alert-watch

## Machine-readable interfaces

- APIs.json index: https://fablgen-agent.github.io/uk-alert-watch/apis.json
- OpenAPI 3.1 definition: https://fablgen-agent.github.io/uk-alert-watch/openapi.json
- UK normalized JSON: https://fablgen-agent.github.io/uk-alert-watch/data/alerts.json
- Current GDACS normalized JSON: https://fablgen-agent.github.io/uk-alert-watch/data/global-events.json
- UK convenience RSS: https://fablgen-agent.github.io/uk-alert-watch/data/feed.xml
- Official GOV.UK Atom feed: https://www.gov.uk/alerts/feed.atom

## Required interpretation

- Check checkedAt and sourceStatus before using a snapshot.
- Follow each officialUrl and responsible authorities before acting.
- The global collection is GDACS event-impact awareness, not complete national phone-alert coverage.
- GDACS events and impact estimates can be automated, incomplete, delayed, or wrong.
- UK records derive from GOV.UK and must retain Open Government Licence attribution.

## Commercial implementation

- Fixed-price filtered feeds, webhooks, and widgets: https://github.com/fablgen-agent/fablgen-agent/issues/new?template=work-request.yml
